info.title: [VGE-D-SD06] Start Deck 06: Mirei Minae -Sealed Blaze Maiden- ｜ ｜ Card List ｜ Cardfight!! Vanguard Trading Card Game | Official Website

cards.text:
D-SD06/001EN
Sealed Blaze Maiden, Bavsargra
Normal Unit｜ Dragon Empire｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield
[AUTO](VC)[1/turn]:When this unit is Armed, [Soul-Charge 1], choose a grade 1 or less card from your drop, and call it to (RC).
[ACT](VC)[1/turn]:If this unit is Armed with two or more cards, [COST][Soul-Blast 2], retire all of your opponent's front row rear-guards, and this unit gets [Critical] +1 until end of turn.

D-SD06/002EN
Sealed Blaze Dragon, Halibadra
Normal Unit｜ Dragon Empire｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (VC) by riding from "Sealed Blaze Dragon, Namorkahr", choose an Arms card from your drop, and put it into your hand.
[AUTO](RC):When this unit attacks, if your vanguard is Armed, this unit gets [Power] +5000 until end of that battle.

D-SD06/003EN
Sealed Blaze Dragon, Namorkahr
Normal Unit｜ Dragon Empire｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (VC) by riding from "Sealed Blaze Dragon, Arhinsa", [COST][Soul-Blast 1], search your deck for up to one "Sealed Blaze Sword, Prithivih" or "Sealed Blaze Shield, Swayanbuh", reveal it and put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
[AUTO](RC):When this unit attacks, this unit gets [Power] +2000 until end of that battle.

D-SD06/004EN
Sealed Blaze Dragon, Arhinsa
Normal Unit｜ Dragon Empire｜ Grade 0｜ Power 6000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO]:When this unit is rode upon, if you went second, draw a card.

D-SD06/005EN
Sealed Blaze Dragon, Ulsalra
Normal Unit｜ Dragon Empire｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield
[AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (RC), [COST][Counter-Blast 1], choose an Arms card from your drop, and put it into your hand.

D-SD06/006EN
Elecblow Dragon
Normal Unit｜ Dragon Empire｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000

Sealed Blaze Dragon, Shirunga
Normal Unit｜ Dragon Empire｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO](RC):When this unit boosts, [COST][discard an Arms card from your hand], and draw a card.

D-SD06/008EN
Escort Stealth Dragon, Hayashi Kaze
Normal Unit｜ Dragon Empire｜ Grade 1｜ Power 7000｜ Shield 0
[CONT]:Sentinel (You may only have up to four cards with "[CONT]:Sentinel" in a deck.)
[AUTO]:When this unit is put on (GC), [COST][discard a card from your hand], choose one of your units, and it cannot be hit until end of that battle.

D-SD06/009EN
Spiritual King of Determination, Olbaria
Trigger Unit｜ ｜ Grade 0｜ Power 5000｜ Shield 50000
(You may only have one [Over] trigger in a deck. When revealed as a trigger, remove that card, draw a card, choose one of your units, and it gets [Power] +100 Million until end of turn! If revealed during drive check, activate its additional effect!)
Additional Effect - Choose one of your units, and it gets [Power] +100 Million until end of turn!

D-SD06/010EN
Conduct Spark Dragon
Trigger Unit｜ Dragon Empire｜ Grade 0｜ Power 5000｜ Shield 15000
(When revealed as a trigger, choose one of your units, and it gets [Critical] +1 until end of turn! Then, choose one of your units, and it gets [Power] +10000 until end of turn!)

D-SD06/011EN
Rushing Dragon, Steel Dilopho
Trigger Unit｜ Dragon Empire｜ Grade 0｜ Power 5000｜ Shield 5000
(When revealed as a trigger, draw a card! Then, choose one of your units, and it gets [Power] +10000 until end of turn!)

D-SD06/012EN
Stealth Dragon, Jaengoku
Trigger Unit｜ Dragon Empire｜ Grade 0｜ Power 5000｜ Shield 15000
(When revealed as a trigger, all of your front row units get [Power] +10000 until end of turn!)

D-SD06/013EN
White Light Dragon, Parasolace
Trigger Unit｜ Dragon Empire｜ Grade 0｜ Power 5000｜ Shield 15000
(You may only have up to four [Heal] triggers in a deck. When revealed as a trigger, choose one of your units, and it gets [Power] +10000 until end of turn! Then, if the number of cards in your damage zone is equal to or more than your opponent's, choose a card from your damage zone, and heal it!)

D-SD06/014EN
Sealed Blaze Sword, Prithivih
Normal Order｜ Dragon Empire｜ Grade 3｜ Power ｜ Shield
Right Deity Arms - "Sealed Blaze Maiden, Bavsargra" (After being played, the specified vanguard Arms it. If a new Right Deity Arms is Armed, put this card into the drop)
Play this with [COST][Soul-Blast 1]!
[AUTO](VC):When the unit Armed with this card attacks, that Armed unit gets [Power] +10000 until end of that battle. At the end of that battle, if your opponent's damage zone has four or less cards, [COST][Counter-Blast 2 & put this card into your drop], choose one of your opponent's vanguards, and deal one damage.

D-SD06/015EN
Sealed Blaze Shield, Swayanbuh
Normal Order｜ Dragon Empire｜ Grade 3｜ Power ｜ Shield
Left Deity Arms - "Sealed Blaze Maiden, Bavsargra" (After being played, the specified vanguard Arms it. If a new Left Deity Arms is Armed, put this card into the drop)
Play this with [COST][Counter-Blast 1]!
[AUTO](VC)[1/turn]:When the unit Armed with this card is attacked, that Armed unit gets [Power] +10000 until end of that battle.
